entries.reason: the window is nsec sections of five values each at start_sec, and a section the setup does not have is left alone
entries.effect: the five coefficients of each section the window names become the given values, and nothing else changes: the caller's delay is the filter's state and the setup holds none, so a run over the same delay answers what a setup made from those coefficients answers over it
entries.source: the host's own vDSP, held against the port for every case by tests/backports/host/vdspbiquad15, which builds a setup with each side's own vDSP_biquad_CreateSetup, calls each side's own setter on it and reads the change back through each side's own vDSP_biquad - the setup is never read on either side and never crosses, so nothing needs a layout both agree on; the header of iOS 16.4 for the declaration; the release's own armv7 caches, which say which release first exports the name
